LH001.title: How to Cultivate Concentration
LH001.summary: Short verses on the stages of calm abiding: how to settle a scattered mind and build steady concentration.

LH002.title: Importance of Mindfulness and Vigilance
LH002.summary: Why runaway, wild thoughts cause trouble, and why mindfulness and vigilance are needed at all times.

LH003.title: Practice of Śamatha
LH003.summary: A detailed step-by-step guide to calm-abiding meditation, from posture to a still, concentrated mind.

LH004.title: Profound Śamatha Instruction
LH004.summary: A profound instruction on calm abiding in which the mind turns to look at itself.

LH005.title: Mindfulness: The Mirror of the Mind
LH005.summary: Blunt, humble encouragement to rely on mindfulness as the mirror that shows what the mind is doing.

LH006.title: Transforming Suffering and Happiness
LH006.summary: A famous practical guide to using every experience, good or bad, happy or sad, as part of the path; for hardship and setbacks.

LH007.title: Transforming Sickness etc.
LH007.summary: How to face sickness, poverty and death, as well as health and success, with joy and without hope and fear.

LH008.title: Bringing Sickness onto the Path
LH008.summary: Three ways, best to simplest, of using pain and illness as part of spiritual practice.

LH009.title: The Universal Medicine for Healing All Ills
LH009.summary: A playful, consoling text written for a student who fell ill, on the real nature of sickness.

LH010.title: Eight Verses of Training the Mind
LH010.summary: Eight short verses on cherishing others, humility and taking defeat upon oneself; a classic for anger, conflict and difficult people.

LH011.title: 37 Practices of Bodhisattvas
LH011.summary: Thirty-seven verses on the bodhisattva way of life, including patience when harmed, criticised, insulted or betrayed.

LH012.title: The Bodhisattva’s Garland of Jewels
LH012.summary: Pithy maxims on guarding speech, dropping faults, patience and kindness in daily conduct.

LH013.title: The Four Immeasurables
LH013.summary: A guide to cultivating loving-kindness, compassion, joy and equanimity toward all beings.

LH014.title: Aspiration to Generate Bodhicitta
LH014.summary: An aspiration prayer for developing bodhicitta, the compassionate wish to awaken for the sake of others.

LH015.title: Blissful Path to the Ocean of Bodhicitta
LH015.summary: An aspiration for exchanging self and others: taking on the world's suffering and giving away happiness.

LH016.title: Advice for Meditating on Impermanence
LH016.summary: A moving poem on impermanence and mortality that urges us not to waste this precious life.

LH017.title: Flowers Ravaged by the Frost
LH017.summary: A song reflecting on impermanence after seeing flowers destroyed by frost; for loss and sudden change.

LH018.title: Heart Advice in Four Lines
LH018.summary: Four lines holding the whole path: devotion, not being distracted, remembering impermanence, and compassion.

LH019.title: Brief Introduction to the Bardos
LH019.summary: What happens during and after death, and the key points to remember at that time.

LH020.title: Advice for a Dying Practitioner
LH020.summary: Gentle general advice on preparing for the moment of death, one's own or a loved one's.

LH021.title: Advice on Remembering Parents
LH021.summary: Verses for a monk who felt sad when remembering his parents, on turning that longing into love and practice; for missing family.

LH022.title: Thirty Pieces of Heart Advice
LH022.summary: Thirty verses of heartfelt advice on simplicity, humility, ethics and sincere practice.

LH023.title: Advice on Abandoning the Eight Worldly Concerns
LH023.summary: A short song on letting go of hope and fear about gain and loss, praise and blame, fame and comfort.

LH024.title: Advice from Me to Myself
LH024.summary: Plainspoken, humorous self-advice exposing how we waste time, chase plans and fool ourselves.

LH025.title: Three Principal Aspects of the Path
LH025.summary: A short classic on renunciation, the altruistic heart of bodhicitta, and wisdom: the three essentials of the path.

LH026.title: Advice on Friendship
LH026.summary: How companions shape our character for good or ill, and how to choose friends wisely.

LH027.title: Advice for Beginners
LH027.summary: A very short, practical set of verse instructions written for beginners.

LH028.title: Beginners’ Obstacles to Meditation
LH028.summary: Advice on overcoming three kinds of obstacles that trouble people who are new to meditation.

LH029.title: Heart Treasure for the Warriors
LH029.summary: Atiśa's parting advice on how to lead a spiritual life and leave confusion behind.
